metadata.agent_last_message:
Created [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py). It compiles under Python and passed a basic linear-motion trace check.

The simulator is **not complete** against the supplied specification. In particular, canned cycles, probing, and nonzero cutter radius compensation are not implemented, and the full set of documented validation rules has not been covered. It should not be relied on as a complete RS274 simulator.
